findings.title: design archetype is a claim, not code proof
findings.detail: The diff only adds a retroactive `design.archetype: "Metric board"` narrative that cites screenshots and design_audit.mjs output. Those PNG/JSON artifacts are not present as binary or content changes in the visible diff, so the anti-column / widest-block measurements cannot be re-checked from this patch alone.

findings.title: coverage high-water unchanged with new base
findings.detail: baseCommit moves to 97aa587… while highWaterPct stays 91.66. The diff does not show a re-run result or coverage delta for the new base, so the retained high-water mark is unverified for this commit.

findings.title: derive-assets depends on unshown public mark
findings.detail: Script resizes `public/logo-mark.png` into favicon-96.png and apple-180.png. The visible hunk only adds the script; it does not include regenerated binary assets or proof they were committed and serve transparent (non-solid) ink for fe-favicon-legible.

findings.title: search-options decision refs missing HTML
findings.detail: DECISION.md names option-1-toolbar.html, option-2-sidebar.html, option-3-header.html as pre-React mockups. Those files are not in the truncated visible diff, so the claimed three-option design process is not evidenced here.

findings.title: RunDetailView tests are partial view only
findings.detail: Export of RunDetailView for injectible loading/error/missing/not-found branches is a real structure improvement, and the snippet shows unit expectations for those strings. Full test file and other product changes (search toolbar, SOURCES fetch path, INTEGRATIONS, brand assets, routes) sit in the truncated middle and cannot be verified as correct or complete from the visible portion alone.
